pending.message: Read-only review of your current BrowserBridge diff found one narrow missing negative case before you freeze: `projectRouteAcknowledgement` currently accepts either matchingUserBubble or matchingLegacyUserTurn, while `evidence` is checked only for newUserTurn. Add a binding check that the evidence array contains the marker corresponding to the chosen acknowledgement (matchingUserBubble ↔ matchingUserBubble; matchingLegacyUserTurn ↔ matchingLegacyUserTurn), not merely newUserTurn. Add mismatched-marker regression tests both directions. Keep max array length and existing route/project checks. This avoids trusting an inconsistent acknowledgement tuple. No other source changes outside your two-file lease.
